Frontend: Playwright flows confirm all new UI (Clients page with Acme Dental seed+Unassigned, create/rename/delete, Alerts page with ack buttons+ack-all, Report settings page with signoff textarea, Scan page with schedule checkbox toggling exe filename to TemprudenceScanner_Weekly.exe and one-liner to include schedule=1, Dashboard new stats stat-open-alerts/stat-scheduled/stat-overdue + nav-alerts-badge, Clients column + client-filter on Computers list, Assign client dialog on computer detail with select/site/save testids, Fleet report with fleet-client-select + report-client-input/report-signoff-input applied on blur, Computer report cover page auto-resolves client from assignment). minor.issue: When only client_id (no client_name) is passed, the returned Content-Disposition filename is 'Temprudence_Fleet_Summary_<date>.<ext>' and ignores the resolved client's name - should be e.g. 'Temprudence_Acme_Dental_Summary_<date>'. Root cause: server.py fleet_export() uses the local client_name query var (None) for the filename tag, but the client name is only resolved inside fleet_report(). Fix: resolve client_name before the file_response() call (or return it from fleet_report).

issues: Minor: when 'Schedule weekly rescans' checkbox is OFF, the one-liner still shows the stop-task hint ('Unregister-ScheduledTask ... -Confirm:$false') below the ps1 line. Could be collapsed when schedule is off to reduce visual noise.

action_items: (Minor) Fleet export filename should include the resolved client name when only client_id is supplied.

rca of the issue: fleet export filename bug: in server.py the GET /api/reports/fleet/export handler receives client_name as a Query (default None) and passes it to fleet_report(); inside fleet_report the name is resolved from the client_id if client_name is None, but that resolution is only used for rep['subtitle'] and apply_branding and is not propagated back to the outer handler. The outer handler then computes `tag = re.sub(..., client_name or '') or 'Fleet'` using its still-None local variable, so the download filename falls back to 'Temprudence_Fleet_Summary_<date>' instead of 'Temprudence_<ClientName>_Summary_<date>'. Fix: resolve client_name before `file_response(...)` (e.g. `if client_name is None and client_id and client_id != 'none': client_name = await client_name_for(client_id)`) or have fleet_report return the resolved name alongside the report dict.
